statement: ChatGPT Enterprise users at South Korean companies rose roughly 28-fold year over year through August.
why: Paid enterprise seat growth of this scale in one country is direct evidence that inference workloads, and the compute behind them, keep expanding.

impact.mechanism: More paid enterprise seats raise inference token volume, which pulls through cloud capacity and accelerator purchases.

evidence.excerpt: ChatGPT Enterprise users at South Korean companies surged approximately 28-fold year-over-year through August

confidence.basis: Secondary wire report citing company-supplied adoption figures with no absolute base.
